summary: Comtech Telecommunications filed an 8-K on July 30, 2026, disclosing amendments to its senior and subordinated credit agreements. Amendment No. 5 to the senior credit agreement waives an excess cash flow prepayment for fiscal year 2026 and adjusts the application of 65% of a $10.0 million advance payment from a securities purchase agreement with Wavestream Corporation. Amendment No. 4 to the subordinated agreement is also noted. These are routine debt covenant amendments, not corporate actions affecting shareholders. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring is indicated. What to watch: continued compliance with credit facility terms and potential default risks.
